review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read functionOperatorLevelSet (FullNegativeEndpoint.lean, with a similar def in Solution.lean), operatorLevelSet (ModularFailure.lean) and hasFunctionPhiModularEstimate_iff. I grepped for any membership or simp lemma about these level sets and found none. The finding is about the missing simp interface for the level-set definitions. I did not run Lean, so I don't know whether the suggested lemmas would work as intended with `simp` in the downstream proofs. I found no other simp-related issues, such as loops or competing rules; the file declares no simp attributes.

findings.problem: functionOperatorLevelSet is a plain def of a set-builder with no membership lemma (e.g. `mem_functionOperatorLevelSet`) and no simp-normal form for level 1. Every consumer has to unfold the definition by name with `simp only [functionOperatorLevelSet, ENNReal.ofReal_one]`, or use `change` as in `functionOperatorLevelSet_measure_congr_ae`, to reach `{x | 1 < T f x}`. The two witness theorems then end with differently shaped `simpa only` calls, one adding `operatorLevelSet, lacunaryL0Operator` and the other only `functionOperatorLevelSet`. The unfolding is repeated in four places, so a reader cannot tell which unfoldings matter. A bare `unfold`/`simp [functionOperatorLevelSet]` would expand the definition everywhere, including inside the `volume (…)` expressions where the named set is the intended normal form.
findings.proposed_change: Next to the definition in FullNegativeEndpoint.lean, add `@[simp] theorem mem_functionOperatorLevelSet : x ∈ functionOperatorLevelSet T f α ↔ ENNReal.ofReal α < T f x := Iff.rfl`, and the analogue for `operatorLevelSet`. Add a level-1 form such as `functionOperatorLevelSet T f 1 = {x | 1 < T f x}`, proved by `ENNReal.ofReal_one` and marked `simp`. Then `functionOperatorLevelSet_measure_congr_ae` can use `simp [hx]` instead of `change … rw`. The two witness proofs can then rewrite with a single level-1 lemma instead of the unfold-by-name `simp only` calls. Also add a level-1 corollary of the congr lemma stating `volume {x | 1 < T f x} = volume {x | 1 < S f x}`.
findings.benefit: Callers get a canonical simp rule for membership and for the unit level. The witness proofs no longer unfold a definition by name, and the two near-duplicate proofs become uniform. The definition stays folded in the general modular-estimate statements, because only the membership/level-1 forms are simp lemmas.

evidence.excerpt: change (ENNReal.ofReal α < T f x) = (ENNReal.ofReal α < S f x)
